xrefdescription.para: Requests to capability-gated paths are rejected when capability is disabled

detaileddescription.para: Models gRPC streaming or WebSocket subscription unavailability in a deployment where the feature has not been enabled via configuration.

xrefdescription.para: Non-gated paths succeed even when the optional capability is disabled
Capability flags are correct when capability is enabled vs disabled
Subscribe path is also rejected when capability is disabled
Requests succeed before degradation threshold; fail after threshold

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that callers can detect degradation via error codes and that the adapter provides a well-formed error response for every post-threshold request.

xrefdescription.para: TransportPolicyMiddleware composes correctly with a degraded inner adapter

detaileddescription.para: Valid requests pass the policy layer and hit the degraded inner adapter. Invalid requests are rejected by the policy layer without touching the adapter.

xrefdescription.para: 8 threads mix non-gated (success) and gated (failure) requests concurrently

detaileddescription.para: Validates that the degraded adapter handles mixed concurrent traffic without data races and produces the correct error vs success split.

xrefdescription.para: Every TransportFailureClass produces a non-empty structured message

detaileddescription.para: Validates the Q4 2026 "extend integration diagnostics for protocol-level failure classes" requirement: every failure class must produce an actionable, non-empty message string that operators can triage.
